chunks: As instruction and reminder to every penitent creature.

key_terms.مُنِيبٍ: Penitent or one who turns back

ai.seo_question: What is the Quran described as in relation to the penitent servant?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the Quran as a divine mirror for the repentant servant (‘abd munīb), emphasizing that true insight arises from active return to God rather than passive reading. It underscores the spiritual utility of the Quran as a means of self-correction and divine proximity, aligning with the concept of *tadabbur* (deep reflection) central to Shi‘i hermeneutics.
